title: 12 — RISK REGISTER (expanded per milestone)
summary: Per-milestone risk register with likelihood/impact ratings plus mitigation, fallback, and detection mechanisms for the MMM build.
notes: Not an ADR (no Status/Decision/Consequences) and not a PRD (no user stories/acceptance criteria). Structured tables of IDs with binding mitigation/detection controls tied to named gates and tests → treated as SPEC-level technical constraints rather than prose DOC. Ambiguity between SPEC and DOC resolved toward higher precedence per rule.
